title: Step V: Check for Alternate Paths

blocks.content: Step V: Check for Alternate Paths
Once again, we need to check the distance of the alternate paths. This ensures that we are choosing the path with the shortest distance.
Since vertex D and vertex E are already adjusted to the shortest possible path from vertex A, their assigned weights can no longer be changed.

blocks.alt: Check for Alternative Paths to Reach F

blocks.content: So, we only need to check the shortest path for vertex F.
We have three possible paths to reach vertex F, each with varying costs:

blocks.alt: Compare the Path Lengths for Each Alternate Path for vertex F

blocks.content: Here, the shortest path is the path with distance 8. So, let's update the vertex F with a weight of 8.

blocks.alt: Update Shortest Path to Vertex F

blocks.content: With this, we have found the shortest path from the starting vertex A to every other vertex in the graph.
So, if we had to find the shortest path from A to any other vertex, we just follow along the purple lines that lead to that vertex starting from A.

blocks.alt: Final Graph With the Shortest Path From vertex A

blocks.content: From the figure, A -> C -> E -> F is the shortest path from vertex A to F with distance 8.
Similarly, the path from A to D will be A -> C -> D with a path cost of 7.
